seasonal_note: Seasonal context: November and early December reflect pre-Christmas wholesale giftware stocking, which lifts weekly revenue and order volume well above early-autumn baselines.

show_work.definition: Gross revenue minus the value of cancelled (returned) lines.
show_work.caveats: Returns are booked in the week of the cancellation invoice, not the week of the original sale.
show_work.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-28' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-12-05'

show_work.caveats: One invoice can contain several categories, so orders by category do not add up to total orders.
show_work.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' THEN invoice END) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-28' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-12-05'

show_work.definition: Gross revenue divided by the number of orders.
show_work.caveats: With a category filter this is category revenue per order that contains the category.
show_work.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' THEN invoice END), 0) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-28' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-12-05'

show_work.definition: Number of distinct identified customers with at least one sale in the period.
show_work.caveats: Guest orders have no customer ID and are not counted.
show_work.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' AND NOT is_guest THEN customer_id END) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-28' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-12-05'

show_work.definition: Share of identified customers in the period whose order was not their first order in this dataset.
show_work.caveats: The data starts in December 2009, so customers who bought before then look new. Early months understate this rate and inflate "new" customers.
show_work.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' AND customer_type = 'returning' THEN customer_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' AND NOT is_guest THEN customer_id END), 0) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-28' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-12-05'

show_work.definition: Returns divided by gross revenue, by value.
show_work.caveats: Returns and sales in the same period are not necessarily the same orders.
show_work.sql: SELECT -SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'return' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-28' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-12-05'

drivers.total_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-28' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-12-05' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS current, SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-21' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-28' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS previous, COUNT(*) AS rows_scanned FROM lines WHERE ((invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-28' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-12-05') OR (invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-21' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-28'))

summary.text: During the week of 2011-11-28, retail performance delivered a total net revenue of £306,115, representing a week-over-week change of +3.7% compared to £295,233 in the prior period. However, this result sits at -6.0% below the prior 4-week average of £325,708. Sales volume reached 663 orders, which is a +7.6% increase over the previous week's 616 orders, while the average order value stood at £466.64, marking a decrease of -4.9% against the earlier £490.90 figure. Growth was primarily driven by the Signs and Wall Art category and geographic performance from the United Kingdom, which recorded £277,739.02 in current sales. Additional key metrics include 514 customers, a repeat customer rate of 94.6%, and a return rate of 1.1%. Overall, steady order volume helped lift weekly revenue despite a lower average order value compared to recent trends.
